laboratory.note: Stress falls on the second syllable in British English and the first in American English.

senses.definition: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments, research, or teaching.
examples: The samples were sent to an independent laboratory.
She runs a laboratory studying sleep and memory.
No food or drink is allowed in the laboratory.

senses.definition: Time when you are free from work or duties and can do what you enjoy.
examples: He reads history in his leisure time.
The town has invested heavily in leisure facilities.
Read the contract at your leisure and call me next week.

senses.definition: According to the exact meaning of the words, without exaggeration or metaphor.
examples: The word 'algebra' comes from Arabic and literally means 'reunion of broken parts'.
He was literally the last person to leave the building.
